html:
Soviet pilot who on 12 April 1961 became the first human to travel into space.

He was born in 1934 in a village west of Moscow, the son of a carpenter on a collective farm, and lived through the German occupation as a child. He trained as a foundry worker, learned to fly at a club and became an air force pilot. In 1960 he was picked for the first group of cosmonauts.

His spacecraft, Vostok 1, launched from Baikonur in Kazakhstan, circled the Earth once and landed after about 108 minutes. The flight was planned by the chief designer Sergei Korolev, four years after Sputnik 1.

It was a huge win for the Soviet Union in the Space Race and pushed the United States to aim for the Moon. Gagarin toured the world as a hero. He never flew in space again, and he was killed in 1968 when his training jet crashed. 12 April is kept in Russia as Cosmonautics Day.
sum: Soviet pilot who on 12 April 1961 became the first human to travel into space.
